- Focus: Not Only Sunbathing
- Materials: vocabulary cards, audio, reading handout
Warm-up: say one word you already know for this topic.
Recycles the present continuous from Lesson 2.10.
Recycled language: beach, sunbathe, swim.
Answer from memory: which word belongs to this topic?
Which word belongs to this topic?
Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

beach — the sand next to the sea. Example: We enjoy the beach.
sunbathe — to sit in the sun. Example: They sunbathe in the morning.
swim — to move through water. Example: She swims every day.
sightseeing — visiting famous places. Example: We are doing sightseeing today.
museum — a place with objects to look at. Example: They are visiting a museum.
activity — something you do. Example: Swimming is a holiday activity.
holiday — time away from work or school. Example: It is a holiday activity.
tourist — a person visiting a place. Example: The tourists are at the museum.
enjoy — to like doing something. Example: I enjoy doing nothing.
visit — to go to see a place or person. Example: We visit a museum today.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What are you doing today?
• We are visiting a museum.
• I usually swim in the morning.
• It is a holiday activity.
• We enjoy the beach.
Vocabulary practice: choose the correct word.
Which word means 'the sand next to the sea'?
Which word means 'to sit in the sun'?
Complete the sentence with a word from the list.
Contrast the two tenses with stress.
She IS swimming now, but she USually swims at seven.
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Present continuous vs present simple.
Use the present continuous for actions now and the present simple for habits: She is swimming now. She usually swims in the morning.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct sentence.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: She usually swims in the morning.

elements.content: Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
Today the tourists are not only sunbathing. They are visiting a museum and doing sightseeing. In the evening they usually swim and enjoy the beach.

elements.placeholder: What are the tourists doing today?
What do they usually do in the evening?

elements.content: Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: What are you doing today? B: We are doing sightseeing and visiting a museum. A: Do you usually sunbathe? B: Yes, but not today.
Speaking: Pair and group tasks: Plan a holiday day and describe what everyone is doing.

• What are you doing today?
• We are visiting a museum.
• I usually swim in the morning.
Writing: Write four to five sentences about "Not Only Sunbathing" using the target grammar.
